name: Mountain Climber
summary: A dynamic plank exercise that trains the trunk and shoulders while driving the knees in alternation for conditioning.
setup: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze glutes.
Place hands on a low sturdy bench to make it easier.
execution: Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs, returning one foot back as the other comes forward.
Keep hips level and shoulders over hands.
Alternate at a pace you can control.
mistakes: Hips bouncing up: lower them to a straight line and slow down.
Hands drifting forward: keep them under the shoulders.
Rushing with short steps: take a full range of motion at a controlled pace.
